body.name: Conditional deterministic pilot envelope
body.construction:
For any continuous functions \(A,B:\mathcal K\to(0,\infty)\), define
\[
\Phi(t)=\max_{\beta\in\mathcal K}
\left\{A(\beta)t+\frac{B(\beta)}{t}\right\},
\qquad
t^\star=\operatorname*{argmin}_{t>0}\Phi(t),
\qquad
C^\star=\Phi(t^\star).
\]
These are deterministic envelope objects; their connection to \(\mathcal E_n\) requires the explicit premises of \(\mathrm{prop{:}balanced\text{-}grid\text{-}argmin\text{-}transfer}\).
